Svar på de vanligaste frågorna om Prolin: Answers to the most common questions about Prolink – how requests work, how to send quotes and how payment is handled.
Prolink är en svensk marknadsplats som k: Prolink is a Swedish marketplace that connects businesses and private individuals with qualified freelancers. You can post requests and receive quotes, or offer your services and reach new clients.
Kostar det något att använda Prolink?: Does it cost anything to use Prolink?
Nej — det är helt gratis att skapa konto: No – it is completely free to create an account, post requests and publish services. Prolink takes no commission. The provider invoices the client directly.
Behöver jag ett företag för att registre: Do I need a company to sign up?
Nej. Både privatpersoner och företag kan: No. Both private individuals and companies can use Prolink, whether you are a client or a freelancer.
Hur lägger jag ut ett uppdrag?: How do I post a request?
Skapa ett konto som uppdragsgivare, klic: Create an account as a client, click “Publish request” and describe what you need help with. You can set a budget or leave it open. Freelancers in the category are notified and can send quotes.
Hur fungerar offertsystemet?: How does the quote system work?
En leverantör skickar en offert med pris: A provider sends a quote with a price (fixed or hourly), a timeline and a description. As the client you can accept, decline or chat with the provider before you decide.
En leverantör kan inte ta tillbaka en sk: A provider cannot withdraw a quote that has been sent, but the parties can always reach an agreement in the chat. The client can decline the quote at any time before it is accepted.
Vad händer när jag accepterar en offert?: What happens when I accept a quote?
Övriga offerter på samma uppdrag avvisas: The other quotes on the same request are declined automatically. You and the provider can communicate through the built-in chat. The provider marks the work as delivered when it is done, and you confirm completion.
Prolink hanterar inga betalningar. Lever: Prolink does not handle any payments. The provider invoices the client directly outside the platform, by invoice, Swish or an agreed payment method.
Vad händer om leverantören inte leverera: What happens if the provider does not deliver?
Prolink kan inte medla i tvister eller g: Prolink cannot mediate disputes or guarantee delivery. We recommend that the parties agree on terms in advance and use the chat to document what the assignment includes.
Kan jag vara både uppdragsgivare och fri: Can I be both a client and a freelancer?
Ja. Du kan byta roll när som helst från: Yes. You can switch roles at any time from your profile. Your requests and reviews are kept, and your services are hidden while you are a client and shown again when you switch back.
Hur ändrar jag min profilbild?: How do I change my profile picture?
Gå till din profil och klicka på profilb: Go to your profile and click the profile picture. You can upload an image of up to 2 MB (JPG, PNG or WebP). If you signed in with Google, your Google profile picture is fetched automatically.
